info.title: BAC Testing API
info.description: OpenAPI schema generated from the live Django REST Framework routes. This file documents reachable operations, including default router methods. It is a documentation export, not a security verdict.

get.description: Returns the 100 newest audit log rows, newest first, wrapped in data. Each row records the actor, action, endpoint, target user, status code, and time. Only an admin can call it.

403.description: Authenticated caller is not permitted for this operation

get.description: Returns every audit log whose actor is the user id in the path, plus that user's id and username. Only an admin can call it. A missing user id returns 404.
get.summary: List audit logs for one actor

403.description: Authenticated caller is not permitted for this operation

get.description: Returns counts of users, documents, payroll rows, and leave requests grouped by pending, approved, and rejected. Only an admin can call it.

403.description: Authenticated caller is not permitted for this operation

post.description: Creates a user with a hashed password. Only an admin can call it. Send username, password, email, and role. first_name and last_name are optional. A username that already exists returns 400.

403.description: Authenticated caller is not permitted for this operation

get.description: Returns attendance rows wrapped in data. An admin sees every employee. Any other authenticated user sees only their own rows.

post.description: Creates one attendance row for the logged-in user. Send work_date. The server sets the employee to the caller and status to present. A second row for the same employee and date returns 400.

get.description: Returns one attendance row by id. The employee who owns the row and an admin can read it. Another employee receives 403 when the row exists, or 404 when it does not.

403.description: Authenticated caller is not permitted for this operation

put.description: Updates work_date on an existing row. Only an admin can save changes. The owner may open the row but receives 403 on this write. The employee, check-in, check-out, and status fields stay server-controlled.

403.description: Authenticated caller is not permitted for this operation

post.description: Records the logged-in user's check-in for the current local date. No request body is required. Creates today's row when it is missing. Returns 400 when a check-in time is already stored.
Records the logged-in user's check-out for the current local date. No request body is required. Returns 400 when there is no check-in yet, or when a check-out time is already stored.

Public login. No JWT is required. Send username and password. A valid account returns access and refresh tokens plus user_id, username, and role. Missing or wrong credentials return 401 with {"error": "Invalid credentials"}.
Records a logout for the logged-in user and returns a success message. A valid JWT is required. The server does not revoke the access or refresh token.

get.description: Returns the logged-in user's profile: id, username, name, email, role, and created_at. A valid JWT is required. The body is the profile itself, not wrapped in data.
Returns benefit plans whose is_active flag is true, wrapped in data. Any authenticated user can read this catalog. Inactive plans are omitted.

post.description: Creates a benefit plan with a name, description, monthly cost, and active flag. Only an admin can create a plan. Other authenticated users receive 403.

403.description: Authenticated caller is not permitted for this operation

get.description: Returns one benefit plan by id, including inactive plans. Any authenticated user can read it. A missing id returns 404.

put.description: Updates the name, description, monthly cost, or active flag of one plan. Only an admin can save changes. Send the fields you want to change. Other authenticated users receive 403 when the plan exists.

403.description: Authenticated caller is not permitted for this operation

get.description: Returns benefit enrollments wrapped in data. An admin sees every enrollment. Any other authenticated user sees only enrollments where they are the employee.

post.description: Enrolls the logged-in user in an active plan. Send plan_id. The server sets the employee to the caller and ignores a client-supplied employee. A second enrollment in the same plan returns 400.

get.description: Returns documents wrapped in data. Every authenticated user sees only documents they own. An admin uses the same owner filter on this list.
get.summary: List documents owned by the current user

post.description: Creates a document for the logged-in user. Send title and content. file_url is optional. The server sets the owner to the caller.

get.description: Returns one document wrapped in data. The owner and an admin can read it. Another employee receives 403 when the document exists, or 404 when the id is missing.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A unique integer value identifying this document.

403.description: Authenticated caller is not permitted for this operation

put.description: Updates a document. The owner and an admin can call it. Send the fields you want to change. Another employee receives 403 when the document exists.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A unique integer value identifying this document.

403.description: Authenticated caller is not permitted for this operation

patch.description: Same update as PUT. Send only the document fields you want to change. The owner and an admin can call it. Another employee receives 403 when the document exists.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A unique integer value identifying this document.

403.description: Authenticated caller is not permitted for this operation

delete.description: Deletes a document. The owner and an admin can call it. A successful delete returns a message and status 200. Another employee receives 403 when the document exists.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A unique integer value identifying this document.

403.description: Authenticated caller is not permitted for this operation

get.description: Returns download metadata for one document: id, filename, and file URL. This route does not stream a file. The owner and an admin can call it. Another employee receives 403 when the document exists.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A unique integer value identifying this document.

403.description: Authenticated caller is not permitted for this operation

get.description: Returns expense claims wrapped in data. An admin sees every claim. Any other authenticated user sees only claims they submitted.

post.description: Submits an expense claim for the logged-in user. Send category, description, and amount. The server sets the employee and stores the claim as submitted.

get.description: Returns one expense claim by id. The employee who submitted it and an admin can read it. Another employee receives 403 when the claim exists, or 404 when it does not.

403.description: Authenticated caller is not permitted for this operation

put.description: Updates a claim that is still submitted. The owner can change category, description, amount, and receipt URL. Only an admin can change status. A claim that is no longer submitted returns 400.

403.description: Authenticated caller is not permitted for this operation

delete.description: Deletes one expense claim. Only an admin can delete it. The owner can see the claim but receives 403 on this delete. A successful delete returns 204 with an empty body.

403.description: Authenticated caller is not permitted for this operation

get.description: Returns the number of claims and the sum of their amounts. An admin totals every claim. Any other authenticated user totals only their own claims. An empty set reports a total amount of 0.00.
Returns leave requests wrapped in data. Every authenticated user, including an admin, sees only requests they own. Open a single request to read someone else's row.
get.summary: List leave requests owned by the current user

post.description: Submits a leave request for the logged-in user. Send reason, start_date, and end_date. The server sets the owner and stores the request as pending. The end date must be on or after the start date.

get.description: Returns one leave request wrapped in data. The owner and an admin can read it. Another employee receives 403 when the request exists, or 404 when the id is missing.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A unique integer value identifying this leave.

403.description: Authenticated caller is not permitted for this operation

put.description: Updates a leave request that is still pending. The owner and an admin can call it. Send the fields you want to change. Another employee receives 403 when the request exists. A request that is no longer pending returns 400.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A unique integer value identifying this leave.

403.description: Authenticated caller is not permitted for this operation

patch.description: Same update as PUT. Send only the leave fields you want to change. The owner and an admin can edit a pending request. Another employee receives 403 when it exists.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A unique integer value identifying this leave.

403.description: Authenticated caller is not permitted for this operation

delete.description: Deletes a leave request. Any authenticated user can delete a request that exists, including a request owned by someone else. A missing id returns 404. A successful delete returns 204 with an empty body.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A unique integer value identifying this leave.

put.description: Approves or rejects a leave request. Only an admin can call it. Send {"status": "approved"} or {"status": "rejected"}. The response message matches that choice.
put.summary: Approve or reject a leave request

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A unique integer value identifying this leave.

403.description: Authenticated caller is not permitted for this operation

put.description: Cancels a leave request that is still pending and sets its status to cancelled. The owner and an admin can call it. No request body is required. A request that is no longer pending returns 400.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A unique integer value identifying this leave.

403.description: Authenticated caller is not permitted for this operation

get.description: Returns every payroll row wrapped in data. Only an admin can call it. Other authenticated users receive 403.

403.description: Authenticated caller is not permitted for this operation

post.description: Creates a payroll row for a chosen user. Only an admin can call it. Send user_id, salary, month, and year. Bonus is optional and defaults to 0.

403.description: Authenticated caller is not permitted for this operation

get.description: Returns payroll rows for the user id in the path, wrapped in data. That user and an admin can read them. Another employee receives 403 when the user exists, or 404 when the user id is missing.
get.summary: List payroll records for a user

403.description: Authenticated caller is not permitted for this operation

put.description: Creates or updates one payroll row for the user id in the path. Only an admin can call it. Send salary, month, and year. Bonus is optional and defaults to 0. A matching month and year updates the existing row. The response says whether the row was created or updated.
put.summary: Create or update payroll for a user

403.description: Authenticated caller is not permitted for this operation

get.description: Returns performance reviews wrapped in data. An admin sees every review, including drafts. Any other authenticated user sees only their own reviews whose status is published.

post.description: Creates a performance review. Only an admin can call this. Send employee, review_period, rating from 1 to 5, feedback, and status. The server stores the caller as the reviewer.

403.description: Authenticated caller is not permitted for this operation

get.description: Returns one performance review by id. An admin can read any status. The reviewed employee can read it only when the status is published. Anyone else, and the employee reading a draft, receives 403 when the review exists.

403.description: Authenticated caller is not permitted for this operation

put.description: Updates rating, feedback, period, status, or the reviewed employee. Only an admin can save changes. The reviewer is set to the caller. Send the fields you want to change.

403.description: Authenticated caller is not permitted for this operation

get.description: Returns the review count and the average rating. An admin averages every review. Any other authenticated user averages only their own published reviews. An empty set returns a null average.
Returns every user profile wrapped in data. Only an admin can call it. Other authenticated users receive 403.

403.description: Authenticated caller is not permitted for this operation

post.description: Creates a user from the collection route. Any authenticated user can call it. The body accepts username, email, first name, last name, and role. This route does not hash a password, so the new account cannot log in until a password is set elsewhere.
post.summary: Create a user via the collection route

get.description: Returns one user profile wrapped in data. Any authenticated user can read any profile id. A missing id returns 404.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A unique integer value identifying this user.

403.description: Authenticated caller is not permitted for this operation

put.description: Updates a profile. The owner and an admin can call it. Send the fields you want to change, including role. Another employee receives 403 when the user exists.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A unique integer value identifying this user.

403.description: Authenticated caller is not permitted for this operation

patch.description: Same update as PUT. Send only the profile fields you want to change, including role. The owner and an admin can call it. Another employee receives 403 when the user exists.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A unique integer value identifying this user.

403.description: Authenticated caller is not permitted for this operation

delete.description: Deletes a user. Only an admin can call it. A successful delete returns a message and status 200. Another employee receives 403 when the user exists, or 404 when the id is missing.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A unique integer value identifying this user.

403.description: Authenticated caller is not permitted for this operation

put.description: Sets a user role to admin or employee. Only an admin can call it. Send {"role": "admin"} or {"role": "employee"}. Any other value returns 400.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A unique integer value identifying this user.

403.description: Authenticated caller is not permitted for this operation

AuditLog.description: Serialize audit log entries for the admin audit listing endpoint.

AuditLogUser.description: Serialize audit log entries scoped to a single target user.

Document.description: Serialize document records while exposing the owner id as read-only.

DocumentRequest.description: Serialize document records while exposing the owner id as read-only.

ErrorMessage.description: Consistent API error body; validation failures include field-level details.

Leave.description: Serialize leave requests while locking user ownership fields.

LeaveRequest.description: Serialize leave requests while locking user ownership fields.

LeaveStatusRequest.description: Validate admin approval or rejection status changes for leave requests.

LoginRequest.description: Validate username and password fields for the login endpoint.

LoginResponse.description: Successful POST /api/auth/login/ body returned by auth_views.login.

Message.description: Response body used by views that return {"message": "..."}.

PatchedDocumentRequest.description: Serialize document records while exposing the owner id as read-only.

PatchedLeaveRequest.description: Serialize leave requests while locking user ownership fields.

PatchedUserRequest.description: Serialize user profile data returned by API endpoints.

username.description: Required. 150 characters or fewer. Letters, digits and @/./+/-/_ only.

Payroll.description: Serialize payroll records returned to admins or owners.

PayrollCreateRequest.description: Validate payloads used by admins to create payroll records.

PayrollUpsertRequest.description: Validate the payroll fields accepted by PUT /payroll/{user_id}/.

User.description: Serialize user profile data returned by API endpoints.

username.description: Required. 150 characters or fewer. Letters, digits and @/./+/-/_ only.

UserCreateRequest.description: Validate and create a new user with a hashed password.

username.description: Required. 150 characters or fewer. Letters, digits and @/./+/-/_ only.

UserRequest.description: Serialize user profile data returned by API endpoints.

username.description: Required. 150 characters or fewer. Letters, digits and @/./+/-/_ only.

UserRoleRequest.description: Validate role updates for admin-managed user changes.
